chunks: Al-Tawhid and Ma'ani al-Akhbar: My father, from Muhammad al-Attar, from Ibn Isa, from Abi Hashim al-Ja'fari who said:
I asked Aba Ja'far the Second (peace be upon him): What is the meaning of 'the One'? He said: (He is) the One upon whom all tongues agree, in Oneness.
ai.seo_question: What is the definition of 'Al-Wahid' according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Abu Hashim al-Ja'fari asks Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) about the theological meaning of the divine attribute 'Al-Wahid' (The One). The Imam defines it not merely as numerical singularity, but as the consensus of all tongues and languages in affirming His absolute Oneness (Al-Wahdaniyyah). This definition underscores the universal and intuitive recognition of God's unity across all creation, a concept central to Shia theological discourse on Tawhid.
